newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST- Konecranes 8-mth profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- Konecranes 8-mth profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 90 million markka median forecast for cranes maker KCI Konecranes Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on September 26 at 1000/0700 GMT.
In January-August 1995, Konecranes posted a 53 million markka profit.
For Konecranes' full-year 1996 profit, eight of the 12 analysts polled gave a mean forecast of 184 million markka (range 163-208 million). The 1995 profit was 135 million markka.
The data was collected in the fourth week of September.

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Enskilda, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Interbank, Merita, Opstock, Postipankki and Svenska Handelsbanken.
